name: age
description: Modern file encryption with X25519, ChaCha20-Poly1305, and Scrypt

tools.description: X25519 keypair generator with secure defaults and SSH integration
tools.usage:
age-keygen -o key.txt # Generate new X25519 keypair
age-keygen -y key.txt # Extract public key from private
age-keygen | tee private.key | age-keygen -y > public.key # Generate and split
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f ssh.key && age-keygen -y ssh.key # Convert SSH to age
age-keygen -o - | age -r $(age-keygen -y -) secrets.txt # Generate and encrypt

tools.description: ChaCha20-Poly1305 file encryptor with X25519 and scrypt support
tools.usage:
age -r pubkey.txt secrets.txt > secrets.age # Encrypt with public key
age -d -i private.key secrets.age > secrets.txt # Decrypt with private key
age -p documents.tar > documents.tar.age # Encrypt with passphrase
echo 'sensitive data' | age -r pubkey.txt -a # Encrypt and ASCII armor
age -R recipients.txt -o backup.age folder/ # Multi-recipient directory encryption
